_doc: Graphics auto-detect presets (PC EXTENSION; frontend/GraphicsAutoDetect). On first launch (no saved PC settings) or
when the GPU changes, the frontend reads the hardware facts (Rendering's IRenderer::gpuFacts: vendor, renderer name,
VRAM, ray tracing; the window's native monitor mode; CPU cores) and picks the FIRST tier whose requirements the PC
meets ('best look the PC can hold'), then applies its values. The user can change anything afterwards; Graphics ->
Recommended Settings re-applies the pick. Tune by editing this file; no rebuild needed.
allowIntegrated           false: GPUs matching integratedKeywords skip this tier
nativePixelBudget         width*height the tier renders at native without upscaling; above it the tier applies
maxHeight                 0 = native resolution; else the largest monitor-aspect resolution with height <= this
anisotropy 4/8/16, hdTextures (only when the HD pack is installed), textureQuality 0-2, fullscreen, vsync
frameLimit                'refresh' = the monitor's refresh rate, or a number (0 = uncapped)
Ray Tracing and Frame Generation are never turned on by auto-detect (user choice).
